evals.prompt: Authorized campaign: schedule one company feature post daily November 1 through November 4, 2026, at 10 a.m. America/New_York. Two posts already exist for November 1 and 2. Provider accepts only two posts per call. Add official logo. Feature source says it prepares a worksheet, with hosted saving requiring a supported importer. Draft an execution plan and an example company caption plus founder take. Use https://recoupable.com CTA. Do not call real providers.
evals.expected_output: Complete four-date plan; preserve two existing items; no unsupported hosted claim; exact logo overlay; conversational CTA both variants; independent review step.
assertions: Plans all four dates and preserves the two existing posts within the two-post batch limit.
Describes worksheet preparation accurately without implying unconditional hosted saving; does not add a mandatory operational disclaimer to public copy.
Uses the official logo as a separate exact overlay rather than generated logo pixels.
Provides a conversational website CTA in both company and founder examples.
Includes independent review before scheduling without claiming the dry run performed it.
Uses correct local/UTC timestamps for the November 1–4 morning slots.

evals.prompt: Schedule a daily company original and native founder repost for December 1–3. Provider supports company originals but cannot schedule dependent native reposts. No company original has been published. User authorized existing daily repost follow-up. Explain exact deliverables and state ledger; do not call providers.
evals.expected_output: All three company slots handled; founder copy pending native repost after verified originals; no standalone substitutes or false scheduled repost claims.
assertions: Plans all three company dates while leaving native reposts pending original publication.
Does not substitute standalone founder posts for native reposts.
Uses the existing authorized follow-up and checks for prior reposts before retry.
Distinguishes verified company scheduling from live publication and native repost completion.

evals.prompt: A campaign batch timed out after creating a post. One post ID was returned, another outcome is unknown. Image renderer returned success but final image has blank background. Company copy was edited after review. Describe recovery and completion criteria; do not call providers.
evals.expected_output: Reconcile before retry, preserve known IDs, rerender and visually inspect, invalidate copy hash/review, no completion from tool success.
assertions: Preserves known IDs and reconciles the unknown create before retrying only missing work.
Rejects renderer success as proof; repairs and visually inspects the final exported asset.
Invalidates review for edited copy and ties renewed review to the exact current version or hash.
Requires provider readback and distinguishes scheduled state from live publication.

evals.prompt: Synthetic source: an AI agent compares supplied purchase orders and invoices, flags mismatches with source references, and leaves approval and changes to a human. The skill is free; its AI client is separate. Create a thumbnail hook and a caption-independent carousel storyboard. An approved thumbnail has an orange brand background; supporting art does not exist. Explain reuse, generation and review. Do not call providers, spend or publish.
evals.expected_output: Headlines alone explain the AI agent, inputs, findings/evidence, human decision and free skill. Reuse cover art on its matching orange field; create simple supporting narrative scenes.
assertions: Thumbnail hook makes the AI/agent task clear without a caption.
Headline sequence explains input, agent action/output and human decision without body copy.
Reuses cropped cover artwork on a matching seamless background rather than regenerating it or hard-coding blue.
Plans narrative-specific supporting Higgsfield scenes, one concept per card, without claiming actual generation.
Offers the free skill accurately without implying free AI client usage or adding a pricing disclaimer; includes a conversational website CTA.
Includes headline-only, caption-hidden and phone-size review; three-second comprehension is a target, not a measured outcome.

evals.prompt: Existing carousel illustrations and original thumbnail artwork are approved and suitable. Its headlines say only Gather / Compare / Act and explain AI only in small text. Revise the copy and describe which artifacts and provider state change. Do not call providers.
evals.expected_output: Copy-layer repair with explicit agent narrative, suitable artwork retained, refreshed dependent exports and review, no new generation or scheduling mutation.
assertions: Repairs headline-only comprehension by naming AI/agent and distinguishing agent action from human decision.
Preserves all suitable artwork; no fresh generation for a copy-only repair.
Refreshes affected composed exports, alt text, transcript, preview, review and hashes.
Does not replace scheduled originals or create duplicate posts as part of drafting.

evals.prompt: A carousel closing card repeats Get the free invoice review skill and adds Reviews supplied invoices. Does not approve payments. The user says operational scope belongs in the installed skill and posts should get people to try it. Simplify the card and explain your editorial treatment. The agent flags invoice mismatches; it does not pay invoices. No providers or generation.
evals.expected_output: One invitation and destination. Remove boilerplate without relocating it to earlier cards. Describe mismatch detection accurately and leave operating scope to the installed skill.
assertions: Closing card contains one clear offer invitation and destination only, with no duplicated invitation or new explanation.
Removes scope boilerplate without moving it to another card; keeps the actual mismatch-detection claim accurate and does not promise automatic payment.
Preserves suitable artwork; updates copy and affected exports only.
